Subject: Quarrow Auto Care - Referral Required

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the submission on Quarrow Auto Care. I've reviewed the information and everything looks complete—appreciate the thorough package!

However, auto care/repair risks require referral to our senior underwriting team for approval. Before I send this up, could you help me with a few questions?

- What specific auto services do they provide (repair, body work, detailing, etc.)?
- Do they perform any painting or spray operations?
- What are their annual revenues?
- Any environmental exposures or hazardous waste handling?

Once I have these details, I'll escalate this for review. Alternatively, if you need a quicker turnaround, a specialty auto program might be a better fit—happy to suggest some markets if helpful.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
